role: Developer tool: removes a Swift file's PBXBuildFile, PBXFileReference, group-child and Sources-phase entries from project.pbxproj by basename, optionally deleting the file (--delete). Not referenced by any script/Makefile/workflow.
toplevel: Module constant PROJECT path (relative to cwd). `if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(main())`.

units.does: Regex-removes, for an exact basename, all `<id> /* name in Sources */ = {isa = PBXBuildFile...` lines, `<id> /* name */ = {isa = PBXFileReference...` lines, `<id> /* name */,` group children and `<id> /* name in Sources */,` phase entries; returns new content and count notes.

branches.cond: any PBXBuildFile ids were found for the basename
branches.effect: append '(build file ids: ...)' note; otherwise no extra note. All four re.subn removals run unconditionally and report their counts (0 when nothing matched).

flags.text: Matching is by basename only: if two different files share a name in different groups/directories, every entry for that name is removed, not just the one at the given path (no duplicate basenames exist in project.pbxproj at 8d32097).

units.does: CLI: strips --delete, prints usage (return 2) with no args, return 1 if pbxproj is not under cwd; for each path warns if basename absent, applies remove_file, optionally os.remove()s the file; writes pbxproj back unconditionally.

branches.cond: Emuqu.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj not found relative to cwd
branches.effect: stderr 'run from the repo root', return 1

branches.cond: basename substring absent from pbxproj text
branches.effect: print warning only; removal still runs (no-op) and notes are printed
os.remove(path) and print; otherwise file left on disk. After the loop pbxproj is rewritten unconditionally.
